closure_policy: A correction-control row cannot close a live gap. It can block premature reliance on a released output until defect intake, information-quality routing, withdrawal/retraction, notification/redress, version/citation hygiene, and harm review are complete outside the cube.

allowed_cube_artifacts: public output locator and version label if one later exists
FCC-HC-001.closure_blocker: Blocks housing affected-person and material-outcome closure until any public-output defect is routed, correction/withdrawal status is resolved, downstream citations are updated, disclosure/harm review is complete, and separate household-tail evidence proves possession, re-housing, screening correction, retaliation safety, or durable stability outside the cube.
FCC-HC-001.control_label: Housing household post-release correction, withdrawal, redress-routing, and no-outcome-by-corrigendum control
correction_artifacts_required: public-safe correction intake ledger with defect class and locator only
information-quality correction request route and owner outside the cube
withdrawal, retraction, republication, or no-change decision record outside the cube
affected-party notification and redress-routing determination outside the cube
public version warning, replacement pointer, and tombstone if an output is withdrawn
harm review and disclosure-risk reassessment before any corrected output is relied upon
correction_request_controls: route information-quality correction requests to the named owner with timeliness and response status
allow affected persons, partners, reviewers, and downstream users to seek correction without creating adverse-action exposure
separate correction-request status from individual redress or benefit/housing remedy status
defect_detection_controls: accept analytic error, denominator defect, nonresponse-bias defect, disclosure risk, source drift, replication failure, and affected-person harm reports as correction triggers
log error class, public locator, and responsible owner without storing private complaint facts in the cube
pause reliance when a defect may change a claimant or household conclusion, disclosure limit, or material-outcome claim
treat address/building inference, docket reuse, landlord/provider/shelter context, and informal-displacement omission as housing-specific correction triggers
harm_review_controls: review participant, community, retaliation, stigma, legal, financial, housing, and disclosure harms before keeping any corrected public output live
treat correction-related harm reports as safety events, not merely editorial complaints
pause reliance while harm review is unresolved or while re-identification risk remains plausible
FCC-HC-001.next_action: Draft a public-safe housing correction-ledger template that separates output correction from household possession, re-housing, screening, safety, and durable-stability outcomes.
notification_redress_controls: notify appropriate owners, custodians, reviewers, and downstream users when a public output is corrected, withdrawn, or retracted
route affected-person redress separately from public correction; a corrected table is not benefit payment, debt waiver, possession retention, or screening repair
document whether participant/community notification is required without placing private notification details in the cube
route household safety, retaliation, screening, court-record, shelter, possession, and re-housing redress separately from public output correction
pause_stop_conditions: pause reliance when information-quality correction request alleges material error, denominator defect, or omission
pause reliance when disclosure risk, small-cell inference, or re-identification risk is found after release
pause reliance when withdrawal, retraction, or supersession affects a cited public output
pause reliance when affected-person redress status is unresolved and a public correction could mask lack of remedy
pause reliance when downstream citation cleanup or public version warning is incomplete
versioning_citation_controls: assign corrected, withdrawn, retracted, superseded, and replaced version labels that make stale citations visible
scan generated surfaces, notes, public summaries, and partner references for citations to the affected output
publish uncertainty and denominator changes with the corrected version where reliance continues
withdrawal_retraction_controls: withdraw or retract public outputs when disclosure risk, serious analytic error, denominator defect, or participant harm cannot be corrected safely
preserve a public tombstone, replacement pointer, and reason class without exposing private details
block republication until disclosure, quality, legal/privacy, and harm reviews are complete outside the cube

correction_role: Non-closing post-release correction, withdrawal, notification, and redress-routing controls for future UI claimant and housing household fieldwork outputs. These controls govern correction posture only; they do not activate corrections, publish errata, notify affected parties, or prove outcomes.
privacy_posture: Raw correction requests, private complaints, participant reports, reviewer workpapers, audit logs, incident details, breach details, legal/privacy analysis, secure-environment outputs, and redress case files stay outside the cube. The archive may store only public-safe correction status, defect classes, version/citation limits, and locator-level public receipts.
